property_summary: For any depositor and deposited amount, the reference contract always successfully returns funds on withdrawAll even if the recipient's fallback uses >2300 gas or reverts (because it uses a low-level call and checks its return), whereas the mutant using transfer will revert or behave differently when the recipient's fallback either reverts or consumes more than the 2300 gas stipend; thus the property: withdrawAll should not revert for a depositor whose fallback consumes >2300 gas and who previously deposited the same amount — the reference preserves this, the mutant can fail.
change_summary: Send value using transfer instead of low-level call, which reverts on failure differently and caps gas, changing observable behavior when withdrawAll completes.
